description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Amending the notice published under the Exchange Control Act - Permission in terms of Sections 7, 10, 11. 15 and 30(5)
categorisation: This gazette notice contains amendments to regulations under the Exchange Control Act, specifically modifying permissions and restrictions related to financial activities. It deals with legal/regulatory matters by repealing and renumbering items in existing financial regulations, which falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
